items.headline: University exams off as staff strike
items.summary: Non-academic university staff staged another token strike, their second in a week, forcing exams and lectures to be cancelled today. They want salary, overtime and allowance cuts from the 2025 budget reversed.

items.headline: Johnston Fernando fined over vehicles
items.summary: The Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court fined former minister Johnston Fernando Rs. 130,000 on three charges of unlawful vehicle possession. He also received a six-month jail term suspended for five years.

items.headline: Vasudeva Nanayakkara at Bribery Commission
items.summary: Former minister Vasudeva Nanayakkara arrived at CIABOC this morning to give a statement in an ongoing investigation. Details of the probe have not been disclosed.

items.headline: Heavy rain over 100 mm forecast
items.summary: Very heavy falls above 100 mm are expected today in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva and North-Western provinces and in Galle and Matara. Thundershowers are likely elsewhere after 1 pm.

items.headline: Marine study ordered on port oil spill
items.summary: MEPA will commission a NARA assessment of damage from the fuel leak at Colombo Port's JCT terminal that reached the Mutuwella coast. Cleanup is reported complete.

items.headline: MPs wear orange against gender violence
items.summary: The PM and Opposition Leader were among MPs wearing orange in Parliament to mark the campaign against violence against women. The PM said around 840 million women worldwide have faced gender-based violence.

items.headline: Opposition flags shrinking key sectors
items.summary: Joint Opposition convener G.L. Peiris said paddy, fisheries, aquarium-fish exports and tea output fell year on year in the second quarter. He argued the Budget does not tackle the decline.

items.headline: Thriposha maize stuck at port, COPE told
items.summary: COPE heard that 2,000 tonnes of maize imported for Thriposha has sat at Colombo Port for almost a year. The importer lacked approvals from the Import and Export Controller.

items.headline: SL, Maldives hold defence talks
items.summary: Defence Secretary Sampath Thuyacontha met Maldivian defence leaders in Male on regional security and Indian Ocean cooperation. The visit was linked to the Colombo Security Conclave.

items.headline: Free smart meters for 300,000 users
items.summary: The Energy Ministry plans free smart meters in 2027 for 300,000 consumers using over 180 units, funded by a US$12 million ADB grant. Four distribution control centres are also planned.

items.headline: Rs. 500 mn loan scheme for fisheries
items.summary: A Rs. 500 million concessionary loan scheme has been announced for the fisheries sector.

items.headline: New elevated highway into Colombo
items.summary: A 5.2 km elevated road linking the New Kelani Bridge to the Port Access Elevated Highway is under way, promising to cut a 40-minute trip to about five minutes. A later extension to Galle Face is planned.

items.headline: Rupee edges up against dollar
items.summary: The rupee appreciated slightly against the US dollar in today's Central Bank rates.

items.headline: Bail for Sri Lankan in LTTE revival case
items.summary: A court in Kerala granted bail to a Sri Lankan accused in an alleged LTTE revival conspiracy.

items.headline: Husband held over Vakarai murder
items.summary: Police arrested a man over the killing of his 23-year-old wife in Vakarai.

items.headline: Six die on the roads in a day
items.summary: Police said six people were killed in separate road accidents on Tuesday, including two motorcyclists and an 82-year-old pedestrian in Moratuwa.

items.headline: Pathirana, Hasaranga in top IPL bracket
items.summary: Matheesha Pathirana and Wanindu Hasaranga have entered the IPL 2027 auction at the top INR 2 crore base price. The mini-auction is on December 16 in Goa, with 1,220 players registered.

items.headline: US readies higher tariffs on 16 economies
items.summary: Washington is reportedly preparing tariff hikes on China, the EU and 14 other countries.

items.headline: Huawei convicted in US trial
items.summary: A US jury found China's Huawei guilty on 10 criminal counts.

items.headline: Houthi strike hits Riyadh tower
items.summary: Eleven people, including Indian and Nepali nationals, were hurt in a Houthi attack on a Riyadh skyscraper. The US has issued a fresh security alert for citizens in the region.

items.headline: Bangladesh lifts garment minimum wage
items.summary: Bangladesh raised the minimum wage for garment workers after weeks of protests.
